prerequisites: For bilingual track students: meet University of Oviedo requirements for bilingual programs
For Spanish track students: basic English knowledge is recommended for software practices and reading comprehension

learning_outcomes.text: Model and solve problems related to the business system
Make decisions related to production management

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, a minimum score of 4 out of 10 is required for both the theoretical and practical blocks. If these minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as (0.65 * T1) + (0.35 * [(P1 + P2 + P3 + P4)/4]). Otherwise, the final grade will be the minimum between the calculated score and 4.0. For the extraordinary call, a theoretical exam and a practical exam are taken, with a minimum of 4 points out of 10 required for each part; the final grade is calculated using the same 65% theoretical and 35% practical weighting. Differentiated evaluation for part-time students replaces practical activities with a single individual practical test.
